_: Words OpenRussian files under the wrong part of speech, keyed on the bare
headword or "bare|pos" when two rows share the spelling. The value is the
class the word actually belongs to.
This matters twice. The class decides whether a word is branch-eligible at
all (build_topics.BRANCHABLE is nouns, verbs and adjectives), and it decides
which paradigm tables panel.py draws — so an adverb filed in nouns.csv is
taught as a noun and the chapter's form question can ask for its genitive
plural. Where the class moves into a closed one, build_lexicon.py also drops
the inflection that came with the wrong file: OpenRussian gives «справа» a
full feminine declension and not one of those thirteen forms occurs anywhere
in the collection, because they are not words.
A stale entry is a build error, not a silent no-op.
